2610.06801.title: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
2610.06801.paper_summary: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a $1.80\times$ denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a $2.32\times$ speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.
2610.06801.paper_summary_zh: 稀疏注意力是減少擴散Transformer在長序列生成任務中的延遲的主要方法，例如視頻和高解析度的3D資產生成。<lb/>然而，現有的方法在高稀疏度下可能會降低生成質量和真實性。<lb/>通過控制的oracle比較，我們將這種降級追溯到三個來源：由標記分組施加的限制、不準確的互動選擇，以及丟棄標記時失去的注意力貢獻。<lb/>根據這一分析，我們提出了Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse)，這是一個無需訓練的框架，能夠選擇單個關鍵值(KV)標記，同時將相似的查詢組織成瓷磚對齊的組，以實現高效的GPU執行。<lb/>MC-Sparse緩存元數據，包括查詢組、使用精確注意力概率選擇的KV索引，以及稠密和稀疏注意力輸出之間的殘差，並在隨後的去噪步驟中重複使用它們。<lb/>在視頻和3D生成模型中，MC-Sparse實現了對稠密注意力輸出的更高真實性和比現有稀疏注意力基準更大的去噪加速，且沒有明顯的質量降級。<lb/>相對於稠密注意力，它在Minimax-H3-Base上提供了$1.80\times$的去噪加速，在3D資產生成上提供了$2.32\times$的加速，且質量損失可忽略不計。
